_comment: Who wrote a post. A post names one of these keys in its front matter; the
default is ben, so a post that says nothing is Ben's.
kind is the field that matters. This site's argument is that a reader should
be able to check a claim rather than take a byline's word for it, so a post
written by an agent has to say so where a machine can read it -- in the
byline, in <meta name=author>, and in the feed entry -- not only in prose the
author happened to include. One post here was written by Orrery and said so
in its own text while every piece of metadata on it credited Ben.
guest marks someone who writes elsewhere and published here once. It changes
